concurrency: Pure validation functions plus the caller limit value; no shared mutable state.
inputs: every candidate value, identity, version, path and bound input
outputs: no partial accepted record on rejection
purpose: Fail closed on malformed, non-finite, duplicate, unsupported, unsafe or over-bound input with a stable categorized diagnostic, distinguishing input rejection, I/O failure, unsupported schema, corrupt artifact, missing evidence and known observation loss, without silently discarding, repairing or substituting anything.
state: Owns no durable state; owns the immutable effective-limits value and the diagnostic construction rules.

static_checks.expected: ast.parse succeeds for every planned path; every emitted diagnostic code is in the frozen closed catalogue
static_checks.rule: python ast parse of the planned limits/diagnostics/artifacts sources plus a check that every diagnostic code constant belongs to the frozen closed catalogue and every EvidenceLimits field is read from the caller value
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

static_checks.expected: ast analysis finds broad boundary handling around parsing/validation entry points, all diagnostic string constants inside the closed catalogue, and a diagnostic-count cap at the emission boundary
static_checks.rule: the reader/recovery/validation paths guard container, type, version, decode, bound and I/O handling and emit only codes from the closed diagnostic catalogue; no uncaught TypeError/ValueError/json decode error escapes; diagnostics are capped by max_diagnostic_count
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

title: ARGUS2-SR-005-U unit specification - Fail-closed validation and caller-configured finite bounds

unit_cases.expected: ValueError raised at construction (library programming error, not an evidence diagnostic); no run is created
unit_cases.precondition: an EvidenceLimits field set to 0 or a negative value

unit_cases.expected: the at-bound event is accepted with no diagnostic; the over-bound event is rejected with ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_event_bytes and no line is written
unit_cases.precondition: one canonical event exactly at max_event_bytes and one one byte larger
unit_cases.stimulus: append the at-bound event, then the over-bound event

unit_cases.expected: the run accepts exactly max_events events; the additional append is rejected with ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_events
unit_cases.precondition: max_events accepted events then one more
unit_cases.stimulus: append max_events events, then one additional event

unit_cases.expected: the at-bound id is accepted; the over-bound id is rejected with ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_id_length
unit_cases.precondition: an event id exactly at max_id_length and one character longer

unit_cases.expected: the at-bound text is accepted; the over-bound text is rejected with ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_text_length
unit_cases.precondition: annotation text exactly at max_text_length and one character longer

unit_cases.expected: the at-bound observation is accepted; the over-bound observation is rejected with ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_payload_bytes
unit_cases.precondition: an observation whose visible bytes equal max_payload_bytes and one whose visible bytes exceed it

unit_cases.expected: the at-bound index is accepted; the additional entry is rejected with ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_artifacts
unit_cases.precondition: an artifact index exactly at max_artifacts and one entry more
unit_cases.stimulus: record the at-bound set, then one additional artifact

unit_cases.expected: the at-bound set is accepted; the additional obligation is rejected with ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_obligations
unit_cases.precondition: a declared obligation set exactly at max_obligations and one obligation more
unit_cases.stimulus: open_run with the at-bound set, then with one additional obligation

unit_cases.expected: the returned diagnostics list length is at most max_diagnostic_count; no unbounded diagnostic list is produced
unit_cases.precondition: an input violating more distinct rules than max_diagnostic_count
unit_cases.stimulus: trigger the violations and count reported diagnostics

unit_cases.expected: the at-bound manifest is published; the over-bound manifest is rejected with ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_manifest_bytes and no run is opened
unit_cases.precondition: a manifest exactly at max_manifest_bytes and one whose canonical bytes exceed it

unit_cases.expected: the at-bound index is accepted; the additional entry is rejected with ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_causal_index_entries
unit_cases.precondition: distinct causal references exactly at max_causal_index_entries and one reference more
unit_cases.stimulus: append the at-bound set, then one additional distinct reference

unit_cases.expected: at most max_read_records records are returned, ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED is reported and the result is a bounded partial result rather than silent truncation
unit_cases.precondition: a run holding more accepted records than max_read_records

unit_cases.expected: exactly one ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED diagnostic naming that field; no diagnostic is produced without an actual violation
unit_cases.precondition: one value violating exactly one declared bound

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-NONFINITE; the value is never truncated, rounded or repaired
unit_cases.precondition: a payload or clock number that is NaN or Infinity

unit_cases.expected: the six required categories (input-rejection, io-failure, unsupported-schema, corrupt-artifact, missing-evidence, known-observation-loss) are present, each diagnostic carries a code whose family prefix matches its category and no two categories share a code
unit_cases.precondition: one input defect per required diagnostic category
unit_cases.stimulus: trigger each defect and collect the reported diagnostics

unit_cases.expected: diagnostics is empty; no diagnostic code is emitted without an actual violation
unit_cases.precondition: a valid run inside every declared bound
unit_cases.stimulus: open, append, import, finalize and read

unit_cases.expected: at most max_diagnostic_count diagnostics are returned and a single ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_diagnostic_count records the cap; damaged input cannot amplify diagnostics without limit (ARGUS2-ADV-02)
unit_cases.precondition: a damaged input (many malformed lines and unknown keys) violating more rules than the caller max_diagnostic_count

unit_cases.expected: bounded stable categorized diagnostics (corrupt-event / unknown-field) are returned as data; no TypeError, ValueError or json.JSONDecodeError escapes the reader or the CLI (ARGUS2-ADV-05)
unit_cases.precondition: an event line that is truncated JSON and another carrying an unknown nested key outside extensions

unit_cases.expected: every case returns an assessed-incomplete bounded result with a stable diagnostic from the closed catalogue; no exception type escapes the reader or CLI (ARGUS2-ADV-05)
unit_cases.precondition: a matrix of malformed containers, wrong-typed members and unsupported version text across the manifest and event lines
unit_cases.stimulus: EvidenceStore.read_run(root) and the CLI verify/export paths
